summary: Verified RouteAccessGuard public-route bypass fix for /welcome. The user-reported 'Checking access / Please wait while we prepare this page' overlay NO LONGER appears on /welcome for unauthenticated users across mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1920x1080) viewports. Protected routes (/dashboard, /features) correctly redirect unauthenticated users to /welcome with return_to parameter.

issues: Minor horizontal overflow detected - may need investigation if user reports scrolling issues

critical_code_review_comments: RouteAccessGuard.tsx lines 376-387: Public route bypass correctly implemented using shouldBypassPublicGuard flag
The bypass checks bootstrapPathnameClean, normalizedPathnameClean, and browserPathnameClean against isPublicRoute()
When bypass triggers, accessLoadingStartedAtRef and accessOverlayDelayStartedAtRef are reset to 0, and overlayState is set to null
context_for_next_testing_agent: RouteAccessGuard public-route bypass verified working. The fix at lines 376-387 in RouteAccessGuard.tsx correctly prevents the 'Checking access' overlay from appearing on public routes like /welcome. Protected routes still redirect unauthenticated users correctly.
